claims.evidence: No wattage label or spec sticker visible on any panel back in the photo; witness noted wattage rating not shown.
Cell count cannot be confirmed from a stacked/leaning view; no flat face-on shot of a single panel provided.
No manufacturer label, logo, or country-of-origin marking is visible; identity brand/model reported as null.
Panels appear used/outdoor-stored but no close-up confirms wear state, cracks, or hotspots.

claims.claim: Battery is new, holds charge for 8 hours, never repaired
claims.evidence: No battery is visible anywhere in the photo; the witness report contains no mention of a battery at all.

risks.risk: Actual wattage/spec may differ from claimed 650W
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the rear spec sticker showing wattage, Voc/Isc, and cell count
risks.if_unproven: price as lowest plausible wattage for this panel size/type

risks.risk: Number of panels included in sale is unclear from a stacked pile
risks.proof: Photo with all panels laid flat and separated, clearly countable
risks.if_unproven: price as a single panel only

risks.risk: Hidden cracks, hotspots, or cell damage not visible in a stacked/leaning shot
risks.proof: Individual close-up photos of each panel's full face, front and back

risks.risk: No proof the panel actually outputs power
risks.proof: Video of a multimeter/clamp meter reading voltage and current under sunlight

risks.risk: Battery claim is unsupported and the battery itself is not shown in any photo, raising scope/bait concerns
risks.proof: Photo of the battery with brand/serial label plus a charge-test video or screenshot
risks.if_unproven: price as if no battery is included

risks.risk: Metal cart/trolley may or may not be part of the sale
risks.proof: Seller statement/photo explicitly confirming cart is included

risks.risk: Claimed Canadian origin cannot be confirmed, affecting resale value
risks.proof: Clear shot of manufacturer nameplate/country-of-origin marking

proof_requests: Close-up of the rear specification sticker on each panel (wattage, cell count, Voc/Isc)
Full-face close-up photos of each panel, front and back, for crack/hotspot inspection
Video of a multimeter or clamp meter test under direct sunlight showing output
Clear photo of all panels laid out separately so quantity can be counted
Photo of the battery with brand/model/serial, plus a charge-level or runtime test video
Confirmation and photo showing whether the cart/trolley is included in the sale
Any manufacturer nameplate or country-of-origin marking visible on the panel frame
response.reason: The witness confirms the item is a solar panel, so it can be priced at worst case despite unverified wattage, origin, condition, and an unsupported, unphotographed battery claim.
